schema.description: Every field is optional; an omitted (or 0) numeric field takes the built-in default policy value (v0). A value outside the range below is 422 validation-failed.

offerTtlMinutes.description: How long a quote stays QUOTED (also capped by the pickup cutoff).

holdTtlMinutes.description: How long a PROVISIONAL promise holds capacity before ReleaseExpiredHolds.

packagesPerOrder.description: Declared packages per order; converts orders to departure packages (G9). Default 1 when omitted or 0.

capacitySharePercent.description: Proportional share of the node cutoff capacity the promise side may use (G9 "D4"). Default 100 when omitted or 0.

transitWindowDays.description: Days of observed load transits the measured-transit read model keeps (ADR 0014). Default 28 when omitted or 0.

transitServiceLevelPercent.description: Service-level percentile quoted against a lane's measured transit (ADR 0014). Default 90 when omitted or 0.

minTransitObservations.description: Observations a lane needs inside the window before its measured transit can push a promise later than the timetable (ADR 0014). Default 20 when omitted or 0.

targetOnTimeProbabilityPercent.description: Share of the promises of a calibration segment the buffer aims to deliver on time; ONE value for every tier (ADR 0020). Default 95 when omitted or 0.

minCalibrationObservations.description: Judgements a segment (tier, basis, node grade) needs inside the window before its buffer applies and its quotes carry a confidence (ADR 0020). Default 50 when omitted or 0.

calibrationWindowDays.description: Days of judgements a calibration segment keeps (ADR 0020). Default 28 when omitted or 0.

maxCalibrationBufferMinutes.description: Cap of a segment's buffer in minutes; 0 switches the buffer off and keeps the confidence (ADR 0020). Default 720 only when the field is omitted.

orderDeadlines.description: At most one deadline per (tier, regionId); a duplicate is 422 validation-failed.

tier.description: Service tier (promise.Tier). CONSOLIDATED is the opt-in tier of a customer-chosen delivery day (ADR 0024): a quote returns it only when its request lists it or names consolidatedDeliveryDay, so a caller that never asks never sees it.
tier.title: Tier

regionId.description: The destination region; absent means every region.

localTime.description: Order deadline HH:mm in the destination delivery station's time zone.
